def factor_highvol_decay(df):
    """Days since last high-volume day, capturing temporal abnormality decay."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high_vol = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)[0]  # is_high_vol
    group = high_vol.cumsum()
    days_since = high_vol.groupby(group).cumcount()  # 0 on high vol day, then increments
    days_since = days_since.clip(upper=60)
    df_copy["factor_highvol_decay"] = days_since
    return df_copy["factor_highvol_decay"]
description: A volume spike often marks a regime change or exhaustion. The time elapsed since the last high-volume day provides a temporal measure of abnormality decay: the longer the quiet period after a spike, the more likely the prior momentum has dissipated, increasing reversal potential.
